_comment: Add these to your agent in ElevenLabs Agents under Agent, Add Tool, Webhook (fill Name, Description, Method, URL, Parameters). Wire each to your calendar or Twilio. Field names must match the Booking record in claude.md.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Return real open appointment slots for a service within a date window. The agent may only offer slots this returns.

service.description: One of the business services, e.g. blocked drain, hot water, gas fitting

date_window.description: Natural window the caller wants, e.g. this week, tomorrow morning, next Tuesday

function.name: create_booking
function.description: Create a real appointment in the business calendar and return a confirmation id. Only call after the caller confirms a slot returned by check_availability.

service.description: Must map to a business service

notes.description: Symptom or detail, e.g. kitchen sink standing water

function.name: send_sms
function.description: Twilio Send Text. Fires the customer confirmation after a booking, or a callback promise. Configured in the platform with Twilio SID + token + number.
